caveman_payload_ultra.P02_ULTRA_SUMMARY: Notebook diff-write SKILL refactor: replace full-file Write with section-overwrite. Each cycle: write `## c<NNN> · <ISO-timestamp>` heading + append cycle entry. Retention: keep last 3 cycles (c<N>, c<N-1>, c<N-2>), prune older sections via Edit+Read+Delete pattern. File-bound ≤200L (hard cap). Blank-state: one-time full Write if no c<NNN> heading exists (bootstrap for forward-only). Solves: notebooks accumulate 1–3 KB per cycle; delta-write + prune keeps history queryable + file bounded. AC-3 retention rule, AC-4 blank-state fallback, AC-5 ≤200L bound. Smoke test: 3-cycle simulation (write c251, c252, c253, verify c253/c252/c251 present, c250–older pruned, file ≤200L).
